minor.issue: Report link /admin/reports?q=<title> — AdminReports uses ?q only to prefill the publisher recipient filter (report-recipient-search, visible only for 'Selected publishers'), not to find the sent report. Clicking a Sent Reports result filters publishers by report title -> empty list. Could not UI-verify (no reports in DB).
count_documents run for every group on every keystroke with unanchored case-insensitive regex across many unindexed fields — fine now, will be slow at scale. want_total param is unused.

ui_bugs.component: GlobalSearch result links for Employee (and pre-existing sidebar)
ui_bugs.issue: Employee who only opened the employee gate (/rt-team-9k4e, localStorage rt_gate_employee=1) gets the HiddenPage 404 when clicking any search result (/admin/leads?search=..., /admin/customers?q=..., /admin/withdrawals?highlight=...). Root cause: PortalSync in App.js shows HiddenPage when portalFromPath(path)==='admin' && !hasGate('admin'). Employee sidebar links (/admin/leads etc.) have the SAME 404 (pre-existing). Works once /rt-control-hb27 was visited. Fix: in PortalSync allow admin paths if hasGate('admin') || hasGate('employee') (or grantGate('admin') on successful employee login).

Two instances (compact in mobile top bar + desktop in title row) both register the window keydown listener, so Ctrl+K opens TWO overlays (count=2 in DOM). On desktop the mobile one is inside lg:hidden so invisible, but on tablets/mobile with keyboard both are visible & stacked. Fix: only listen for Ctrl+K in one instance (e.g. if (!compact)) or render one instance.
React warning 'Encountered two children with the same key 9' on /app/dashboard and /admin (pre-existing, not from GlobalSearch — likely PIN pad/list keys).

issues: Two search icons visible at once: global-search-btn-mobile in top bar AND global-search-btn in page title row (desktop instance not hidden below lg). Hide the title-row one with 'hidden lg:inline-flex'.
Floating AI (sparkle) and WhatsApp FABs render on top of the full-screen search panel (z-index above z-[90]) and overlap results on mobile.
Pre-existing: view-only employee still sees Credit/Adjust/Edit/Pause/Disable/Delete buttons on /admin/customers.

MEDIUM: Prevent duplicate GlobalSearch overlays on Ctrl+K (only one instance should bind the shortcut)
LOW: Hide desktop search button below lg breakpoint (duplicate icon on mobile); raise overlay z-index above floating FABs
LOW: Make /admin/reports?q= actually filter/highlight the sent report (or change report link)

critical_code_review_comments: GlobalSearch.loadMore always requests limit=50 skip=0; for totals >50 users can never see the rest
search_routes.group(): want_total param unused; count_documents on every group per request
Backend permission gating is correct: has_perm used per module, employees group admin-only, customer queries scoped by partner_id/user_id, forced ?group= respects gating
No sensitive fields leaked: projections restrict fields; verified no password_hash/otp/bank/pan/kyc keys
